subject: Web Development
title: Web3 and Blockchain Websites
description: A short lesson to help you apply Web3 and Blockchain Websites.

hook.text: What if websites weren't controlled by any single company or server?

buildup.text: Web3 envisions decentralized apps where data lives on blockchains instead of corporate servers.

discovery.text: Smart contracts can enforce rules without a central authority — no company can change the terms.

twist.text: Web3 hype attracted billions in investment but few everyday users. Most dApps struggle for traction.

climax.text: The promise of decentralization is powerful. Whether blockchain delivers it remains debated.

punchline.text: Decentralization is a goal, not yet a product.

quiz.question: What does Web3 aim to do?
options: Replace CSS with a new language
